visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back in a bun lies on a white bed with rumpled sheets. She rests her chin on her right hand, gazing thoughtfully towards the left side of the frame. The environment is illuminated by a striking bicolor lighting setup, featuring warm red hues from the right and cool blue tones from the left, creating deep shadows and highlights. She wears black lace lingerie. (2) She slowly and deliberately rotates her head toward the camera lens, transitioning from a profile view to a direct gaze. Her facial expression remains calm, steady, and neutral. In the background, a white brick wall is visible, decorated with several hanging dried flower arrangements. There are no on-screen text overlays or graphic elements visible in this segment. (3) She maintains intense eye contact with the camera while slightly adjusting her head tilt to the side. The high-contrast lighting continues to accentuate her facial features and the texture of the black lace against her skin. The camera remains completely static throughout this phase, capturing the subtle micro-movements of her eyes and lips as she poses for the viewer.
